svg.text: CTI Platform : Detailed System Design & Interaction Flowchart
v0.1.0 · FastAPI · React · SQLite · APScheduler · feedparser · httpx · abuse.ch · VirusTotal · AbuseIPDB · Shodan
① SYSTEM OVERVIEW : COMPONENT MAP & PRIMARY DATA FLOWS
VirusTotal v3 · AbuseIPDB v2 · Shodan InternetDB
Dedup: unique index on url / value
Returns list[dict] : rendered by EnrichmentCard component
httpx.AsyncClient · Timeout(15s) · keys checked before each call
auto-detects IOC type via regex if not provided by caller
greynoise_api_key / otx_api_key defined but not yet wired
② APPLICATION STARTUP SEQUENCE (left) · APScheduler 30-MIN LOOP (right)
yield → app now serving HTTP requests
logger.info(f"Scheduled poll complete : {total} new items ingested")
SIGTERM → scheduler.shutdown() called in lifespan cleanup (after yield)
③ DETAILED FLOWCHARTS : RSS POLLING (left) · IOC POLLING + HTTP FLOW + ENRICHMENT (right)
RSS FEED POLLING FLOWCHART : feeds/rss_poller.py :: poll_all_feeds(db)
iterate dict of 8 source → URL pairs
HTTP GET → parse XML/Atom → feed obj
iterate all items in parsed feed
safely get the article URL field
re.sub HTML tags · truncate to 1000 chars
flush all db.add() calls to disk
poll_all_ioc_feeds returns results = {malwarebazaar: N, urlhaus: N, threatfox: N}
HTTP REQUEST LIFECYCLE : from user action to DB response
IOC TYPE DETECTION + ENRICHMENT DECISION TREE : services/enrichment.py
return results: list[dict], each element = {source, fields...}, rendered as EnrichmentCard in IOCExplorer
CTI Platform v0.3.0 · Flowchart Symbols: ▭ = Process ◇ = Decision ⬭ = Start/End ⬡ = Loop target → = Data flow - - = Error/exception path

Left column: RSS feed polling algorithm with all decision branches and loop-backs · Right column top: IOC polling (3 parallel sources) · Right column mid: HTTP lifecycle (3 example flows) · Right column bot: Enrichment dispatch tree
